population: declared random-stratified test identities, first eight unique jobs in canonical sorted order
selection_rule: select the first eight unique job identities after canonical sort from the frozen random-stratified test split; no outcome-based filtering or replacement

conditions.C1: artifact enabled, one validated relevant prior experience
conditions.C2: artifact enabled, one retrieved but irrelevant prior experience
conditions.C3: artifact enabled, two conflicting relevant experiences
conditions.C4: artifact enabled, one prior recovery known to have failed
conditions.C5: artifact enabled, safety conflict rejects the proposed action

decision_time_rule: target identity outcome is unavailable before its decision; prior experience is inserted only before the subsequent condition decision
leakage_controls: no threshold tuning on evaluation cases
claim_boundary: integration composition evidence under bounded Alibaba GPU2020 replay; controlled recovery is simulated and not production self-healing
